criteria.requirement: The tool must deploy collaborative departmental agents (Engineering Agent, Weapons Agent, Combat Systems Agent, etc.) that negotiate drill schedules against shared constraints: ship operational windows, qualified personnel rosters (e.g., Fire Party Leader, EOOW, TAO), and fatigue policies. The multi-agent solver identifies personnel collisions, proposes alternate schedule allocations, and ensures all SFTRM-mandated training periodicities are satisfied.
criteria.detail: Deferred in full: four synthetic sessions demonstrate bounded feasibility only. Departmental agents/negotiation, owner-approved operational fatigue rules, interfaces and SFTRM semantics are absent.

criteria.requirement: No personnel or shared-resource double booking.
criteria.detail: No pair sharing a person or room overlaps. Baseline A is 0–60, B is 90–150, C is 0–60, D is 1440–1500; simultaneous A/C share neither person nor room. — demonstrated by baseline, collision at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Honor availability, qualifications, rest and duty budgets.
criteria.detail: Full sessions fit operating and person windows, qualifications are covered, rest and whole-horizon budgets hold. Baseline P01 rest is exactly 30, each total 120. Rest 31, budget 119, missing Q-A and window end 1499 fail; end 1500 permits D. — demonstrated by baseline, rest-budget, qualification, windows at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish infeasible input from exhausted search.
criteria.detail: B start 0 only is infeasible after complete search; budget 1 reports search limit reached with feasibility unknown; budget 50000 finds B at 90. — demonstrated by collision, search-limit at both viewport sizes.
Deferred: owner recurrence/deadline rules and SFTRM authority are absent. Four explicit sessions do not establish periodicity compliance; future integration must expand and check every occurrence.

criteria.requirement: Have an operator accept the proposed schedule.
criteria.detail: A coordinator inspects the synthetic board and loads and deliberately marks the current feasible draft reviewed. Any edit clears review. No automatic constraint relaxation is available. Actual revision acceptance remains a human review obligation. — demonstrated by baseline, edit-review at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: An interactive weekly schedule board showing automated conflict resolution across departments with one-click schedule optimization and personnel loading heatmaps.
criteria.detail: Deferred in full: this two-day feasibility draft and totals are not a weekly departmental optimization board or heatmaps. Objectives, negotiation and operational calendar integrations are absent.

criteria.requirement: Shows all four synthetic requests A, B, C and D and the whole-horizon minutes for each person.
criteria.detail: All four baseline intervals and fixed assignments appear, with P01 and P02 each 120 minutes across both days. — demonstrated by baseline at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Every result is computed from the current input, with no canned answer, and valid edits recompute it.
criteria.detail: Current inputs drive computation. Editing D duration 60 to 30 recomputes end 1470 and P02 total 90; editing a window can make the problem infeasible with no stale current draft. — demonstrated by edit-review, windows at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Feasible, infeasible, invalid input and search limit reached are four distinct, plainly worded outcomes.
criteria.detail: Feasible draft, Infeasible, Invalid input, and Search limit reached with feasibility unknown are distinct plainly worded outcomes matching the literal journey messages. — demonstrated by baseline, invalid, collision, search-limit at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Never drops or reassigns a request, relaxes a limit or invents a qualification to make a draft fit.
criteria.detail: Search keeps A–D, exact people/rooms, qualification requirements and limits; impossible cases retain the problem rather than dropping requests, reassigning or silently relaxing constraints. — demonstrated by collision, qualification, rest-budget at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Invalid input keeps an actionable error, and infeasibility keeps all requests for correction.
criteria.detail: B duration 0 stays entered with an actionable positive-whole-number error. Impossible B starts retain four requests. Correction recovers feasibility; failed import preserves current work. — demonstrated by invalid, collision, bad-import at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: A person can mark the current draft reviewed, and any relevant edit clears that review.
criteria.detail: Review is bound to the current checked feasible inputs and draft. Relevant edits clear review immediately; imported content never restores trusted review. — demonstrated by edit-review, portable at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Save and import round-trips the exact inputs and draft, and the app works offline from one self-contained index.html.
criteria.detail: Version-1 synthetic JSON round-trips exact structured inputs and draft. Saved D duration 30 recovers after reload and import with end 1470 and P02 load 90. One self-contained index.html works offline without external assets. Node deep-equality round-trip and manual local-file reopen supplement the browser journey. — demonstrated by portable, bad-import at both viewport sizes.

criteria.detail: App and practical README label synthetic practice and not an issued schedule and contain all omissions, limited feasibility and owner-policy warnings in the literal limitations journey. — demonstrated by limitations at both viewport sizes.
